profile.name: Muhammad Shah Jalal
profile.headline: Software Developer
profile.summary: Full-Stack Software Developer with 4+ years of hands-on web development experience, including 3+ years across documented professional roles. Brings over 3 years of experience with WordPress and WooCommerce and more than 2 years specializing in Laravel. Skilled in building scalable web applications, custom e-commerce platforms, REST APIs, backend integrations, and optimized database solutions. Currently focused on AI-assisted development and workflow automation using Codex, Claude, and open-source local LLMs, with practical experience in AI model evaluation, quality assurance, and autonomous multi-platform workflows.

projects.name: RiceStream: Inventory and Financial Management System

highlights.label: ERP Development
highlights.description: Built a specialized management platform for rice mill owners and wholesalers, centralizing inventory, supplier and customer accounts, payments, outstanding dues, and financial reporting.

highlights.label: Modern Monolithic Architecture
highlights.description: Integrated Laravel, React, and Inertia.js to deliver a responsive single-page experience while maintaining secure server-side authorization, calculations, and a single source of truth for financial data.

highlights.label: High-Precision Transaction Processing
highlights.description: Implemented fixed-point arithmetic using PHP BCMath to accurately process weight conversions, variable pricing, stock valuation, payments, and outstanding balances without floating-point errors.

highlights.label: Inventory and Financial Insights
highlights.description: Developed real-time stock tracking, low-stock alerts, automated ledgers, cash-flow summaries, and daily, weekly, and monthly profit-and-loss reports through a unified dashboard.

highlights.label: Database Performance Optimization
highlights.description: Applied eager loading, optimized Eloquent queries, and database indexing to generate account statements from thousands of transaction records with response times below 200 milliseconds.

highlights.label: Business Process Improvement
highlights.description: Eliminated manual due-calculation errors, reduced weekly bookkeeping time by more than 10 hours, and enabled 30% faster inventory-restocking decisions.
